pages.text: The IO Port allows you to rapidly fill or empty $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)storage cells$(/l) to or from $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l).$(br2)It can be rotated with a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wrench)Certus Quartz Wrench$(/l).

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: $(li)The IO Port can be set to move the cell to the output slots when the cell is empty, full, or when the work is done.$(li)If a $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Redstone Card$(/l) is inserted, there will be options for various redstone conditions$(li)In the center of the GUI, there is an arrow to set which direction to transfer items, from the cell to $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l), or from storage to the cell.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: The IO Port supports the following $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrades$(/l):$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Acceleration Card$(/l) increases the amount of stuff moved per operation$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Redstone Card$(/l) adds redstone control, allowing active on high signal, low signal, or once per pulse
